headline: Mid-bounce off the $59,081 capitulation low, stalling at the mean

meta.market_state_note: Daily downtrend just flushed to a capitulation low and is now mid-relief-bounce — favours mean-reversion / divergence-reversal setups, but the bounce is mature and stalling at the mean, so the long is valid yet not actionable at spot ($63.5k).

factors.evidence: Topped ~$82.8k, set a lower high ~$74k, then a high-volume breakdown from the $73-74k shelf to a $59,081 low. Clean LH/LL downtrend; bouncing but no reclaim of the $66.7k breakdown origin.
Price above the cycle-anchor AVWAP — the lone supportive factor, but the anchor is far below and not relevant near-term value.
Oversold, sub-40 — bearish regime, but stretched.
The four largest daily bars (158k / 126k / 163k / 208k) were all crash down-days; bounce volume lighter (108k → 60k).
$59,081 flush → short-term higher lows ($60.6k) → bounce to $64,371; constructive but inside the larger downtrend, capped under $64.6k.
Price $63.5k just above the 20 EMA, just below the 50 EMA — mid-stack.
Price above the AVWAP — slow, low-weight factor given the deep anchor.
Reclaimed the midline and pushing up off oversold.
Impulse-up bar carried volume (23k), but the last two bars thinned out (8.5k → 2.2k) into resistance.

setup.thesis: The oversold relief bounce off $59,081 can mean-revert toward the $66.7-67.1k breakdown origin — but it is mature and stalling at the mean, so there is no high-quality fresh entry at $63.5k. Tactically WAIT for one of two defined edges: a pullback-long that holds $60.5-61.5k with continued CVD support, or a rejection-short at the $66-67k supply / a failed bounce that loses $60.6k for continuation to new lows.
setup.not: Not Trend Continuation (no clean trend to ride mid-bounce off capitulation support); not a confirmed Bullish Reversal (no daily break of structure).

verdict.rationale: The bounce is genuine (capitulation + CVD absorption) but mature and capped by a bearish daily trend; buying $63.5k mid-range into the $64.6-66.7k supply is poor R:R (~1:1). The disciplined stance is to WAIT — buy a pullback that holds $60.5-61.5k (stop < $59,081, targets $64.6k then $66.7k), or fade a rejection at $66-67k.

analyst_summary: BTC is bearish-transitional (4 bearish / 3 neutral / 3 bullish): the daily owns a broken, high-volume downtrend below a bearishly-stacked 20/50 EMA, while the 4H is in an oversold relief bounce off the $59,081 capitulation low with RSI reclaimed above 50 and price back above both AVWAPs.

The actionable event is a genuine capitulation-and-bounce: the largest volume bar of the cycle (208k) flushed to $59,081, a bullish CVD divergence printed at the low, and CVD rose hard on the bounce (-2,975 → +17,125) — real taker buying. But OI fell as price rose (short-covering, not fresh longs) and funding is neutral, so this is mechanical mean-reversion, not a conviction reversal.

Net read is WAIT — the bounce ($59k → $64.4k) is mature and stalling at the mean ($63.2k PR avg / $63.7k 4H 50 EMA), so buying $63.5k into the $64.6-66.7k supply is poor R:R. Buy a pullback that holds $60.5-61.5k (stop < $59,081, targets $64.6k then $66.7k), or fade a rejection at $66-67k.

Notes: this IS the market beta — the quality of BTC's bounce sets the tone for every alt, and $66,700 (the breakdown-origin candle) is the single line between relief-rally and real reversal. Caveat: the on-screen AVWAP (~$50k) is a deep cycle anchor, so 'above AVWAP' is a low-weight bullish factor; the layout's EMA studies weren't returning data-window values, so the 20/50 EMAs were computed directly from Bybit klines.
bottom_line: Countertrend mean-reversion bounce — not trend-following; the discipline is to wait and buy a $60.5-61.5k pullback (or fade $66-67k) rather than chase a mature bounce mid-range where R:R is unfavourable.
